novel_features.name: Millard County land-use sweep
novel_features.description: Sweep every Millard County town in one command and keep only land-use approval bodies (planning commissions, councils, county commission, boards).
novel_features.rationale: The state site is queried one ZIP at a time; only a local registry + dedup turns a whole county into a single call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when the user asks what development/zoning meetings are coming up in Millard County.

novel_features.name: Land-use relevance filter
novel_features.description: Filter any notice set to meetings whose body or agenda involves zoning, subdivisions, rezones, CUPs, variances, annexations, or plats.
novel_features.rationale: Requires scanning inline agenda text against a land-use keyword model the API has no concept of.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this to cut a body's full calendar down to only the approval items that matter.

novel_features.name: New-since diff
novel_features.description: Show only notices first seen since the last run, so a scheduled run reports just what changed. The CLI records what it has seen locally; it does not depend on a separate sync step.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a local store of previously-seen noticeIds with first_seen timestamps; no single API call provides a delta.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this for a recurring/scheduled check so the user only sees new meetings.

novel_features.name: Watch named bodies
novel_features.description: Track a saved list of public bodies (e.g. Delta City Council, Millard County Planning Commission) and report their upcoming meetings across locations.
novel_features.rationale: Requires persisting a user body-watchlist and matching it across the union of location queries.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when the user cares about specific bodies rather than a whole county.

novel_features.name: Agenda keyword scan
novel_features.description: Search the inline agenda text of upcoming notices for arbitrary terms (e.g. a project name, a parcel, an applicant), with surrounding context.
novel_features.rationale: Requires offline full-text search over stored agenda bodies; the site offers no agenda search that works reliably.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this to find every meeting touching a specific project, parcel, or applicant.

novel_features.name: Location registry
novel_features.description: List the curated Millard County town/ZIP set the sweep uses, so the coverage is transparent and editable.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a bundled geographic registry the API does not expose.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this to see or confirm which towns a county sweep covers.

narrative.headline: One command to sweep Utah public-meeting notices for land-use approvals — county-wide, agenda-scanned, and diffed against what you've already seen.
narrative.value_prop: The state Public Notice Website makes you pick a ZIP and click through bodies one at a time. This CLI sweeps a whole county's towns in one call, keeps only planning/council/commission/board meetings, scans the inline agendas for rezones, subdivisions, CUPs, and variances, and with a local store tells you what's new since your last run. Built for tracking Delta City and Millard County development approvals.

quickstart.comment: confirm the PMN endpoint is reachable
land-use meetings across Millard County for the next month
Delta-area approval items for the next two months

troubleshoots.fix: Nothing is scheduled in the window — widen --days or check another town with 'locations'.
The body posted the meeting before finalizing its agenda; re-run closer to the meeting date or fetch the notice detail page.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to monitor Utah public-body meetings for land-use and development approvals, especially across Delta City and Millard County. It is ideal for recurring/scheduled checks where you only want new meetings, and for cutting a body's calendar down to zoning/subdivision/CUP items.
anti_triggers: Do not use this for meeting notices outside Utah — the source is the Utah-only state registry.
Do not use this to register or submit public comment — it is read-only monitoring.
Do not rely on it for legally-binding minutes; always confirm against the official notice detail page.
